classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from proximity, attendance, membership lists, or locality.
Historical directories are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity.
Only explicit self-description supports explicit anarchist classification; adjacent organizations remain separately labeled.

findings.finding: 212 produced a current explicit anarchist organization (NYC Anarchist Black Cross), a current Food Not Bombs group, and a recently closed radical cooperative seed.
215 produced two explicit anarchist organizations (Wooden Shoe Books and Philadelphia Anarchist Black Cross) plus area-code-branded 215 People's Alliance.
218 produced current adjacent mutual-aid/tenant-organizing seeds (Trans Northland and Duluth Tenants Union) but no current explicitly anarchist organization was confirmed in the bounded pass.

data.method: For each authoritative geographic NPA, combine literal NPA searches with locality-derived anarchist, ABC, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective, chapter, and adjacent-organization searches; verify current status from current public sources where possible.
